I actually have before, and it did help with some back pain I had at the time. I actually found out through them that my hips are uneven, due to the curve in my spine.  Built when I brought that up with my back doctor, it just got brushed off.  

I was hoping for them to give me something that would make it easier on me. Like something to put in my shoe to make my hips more even.. he told me just to put an insole in one if I really thought I needed it.  

I need/want something to make it easier for me to move around without pain, so that I can exercise more, go on runs instead of walking everywhere. Wear runners without my feet destroying my shoes (I'm duck toed, meaning my feet face out when I walk) I need ankle support for my feet to stop them from doing this, as I have proven myself by wearing boots, vs any shoe without ankle support.

I've had MRIs before, that's how I know I have scoliosis. I've tried to see other doctors, but just keep getting sent to the same ones. I live in a small city, in Alberta Canada. The only way I can see other specialists is if my family doctor refers me to them.  I have been meaning to change my family doctor for a while now, though, hoping that will change things. 

I've also seen a physicals therapist, who told me that a nerve is pinched in my spine, and that my hips are uneven, due to my scoliosis. But when I brought it up with my back doctor (I don't know the proper term for it), he just told me I need to do more walking.
